facts.fact: The Interior Ministry's deputy secretary-general announced at Tillabéri on 19 August 2026 the ministry's works to modernise the civil-status system: computerisation of communes and declaration centres, a new platform for managing civil-status events to be put into service, and a Registre National d'État Civil to be made operational.
facts.system: nouvelle plateforme de gestion des faits d'état civil

facts.fact: The deputy secretary-general placed the civil-status and identification reforms under the WURI-Niger project, which Le Sahel states is financed by the World Bank (19 August 2026); no domestic budget line is mentioned.
facts.system: nouvelle plateforme de gestion des faits d'état civil

facts.fact: As at 19 August 2026 the computerisation of communes and declaration centres and the new civil-status platform were announced as works to come, not yet in service, following ordonnance n°2026-21 of 22 April 2026 on the civil-status regime and the texts creating the ANEI.
facts.system: nouvelle plateforme de gestion des faits d'état civil
